name: Heavy Support
strategy: Coordinate powerful battlefield assets, artillery, heavy attacks, and conventional forces providing support.

commands.name: Armored Advance
commands.effect: The active Unit gains +2" Move during its next normal Move this Round and Tough 1 against the next ranged Attack it suffers this Round.

commands.name: Fire Control
commands.effect: Choose one visible enemy Unit. The next Attack made against it by each of up to two different friendly Units this Phase gains Accurate 1.

commands.name: Battering Attack
commands.effect: The active Unit gains +1 Attack die and either Anti-Armored 2 or Anti-Monster 2 on its next Melee Attack this Combat Phase, whichever matches the target. The Anti rank applies once to the combined Unit pool and does not stack with another matching Anti rank.

commands.name: Shock Support
commands.effect: When the active Unit declares a Charge this Assault Phase, reroll one Charge die (which cannot already have been rerolled). If the charging Unit began that Charge within Short of a friendly Large Asset, it also ignores up to 2 of the defender's Brace X against the resulting Impact. The original Charge declaration limits apply.

commands.name: Spotter's Call
commands.effect: During the active Unit's Assault activation, designate one visible enemy Unit. Choose one different friendly Artillery or Large Asset Unit within Short of the active Unit. That designated ally gains Accurate 2 and reduces the target's effective Cover X by 1 (minimum 0) on its next ranged Attack against the marked enemy this Assault Phase. This delegated support does not grant an extra Attack or activation.

doctrineIdentity: Concentrated force and coordination around powerful weapons or battlefield assets. Heavy Support is useful even without multiple Large Assets, but its additional A slots and selected bonuses reward armies investing in them.
